svg.title: From a local image to a look you choose
svg.desc: Workflow illustration: an agent opens a local image, the MCP Apps studio previews algorithms and palettes in memory, and an explicit Save image action creates a new file. The image examples are actual dither-mcp renders. This is not a screenshot.

g.text: Your image. Your colors. Your next creation.
Open with your agent. Explore in the studio. Save when the look feels right.
Select Save image and a new path.
Previews stay in memory. Saving creates a new workspace file.
